subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: After the import cycle is repaired, should accepted gateway disconnects immediately recook in a fresh session, or should this PR be extended to retrieve the detached run first?
rationale: Both paths avoid same-session transcript corruption, but they make different user-visible choices about streaming, duplicate tool effects, model cost, and possible duplicate delivery; repository policy treats fallback behavior as a product decision.

options.title: Land narrow isolation
options.body: Repair the import topology, merge the fresh-session mitigation, and leave reattach-first recovery to the related issue.

options.title: Extend to reattach-first
options.body: Expand this PR to await and recover the accepted gateway run before using fresh-session fallback as a last resort.

options.title: Pause pending direction
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers settle the complete disconnect-recovery policy in the related issue.

recommendation.title: Land narrow isolation
recommendation.body: Repair the import topology, merge the fresh-session mitigation, and leave reattach-first recovery to the related issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The gateway-first CLI path and most of its fallback and session behavior trace to this feature history.
